design_context: Hydrophilic/functional block B in an amphiphilic binary poly(amino acid) system P(X)-b-P(B) for tumor-vaccine antigen delivery.
decision_dimensions: dendritic-cell maturation, antigen-presentation or immune-activation relevance
transferability to a poly(amino acid) functional block
rules: Use only supplied evidence cards for candidate-specific claims.
Do not use knowledge of the team's experimental final candidate as a label during K/R/H identity selection.
Do not equate number of retrieved papers with candidate quality.
Do not force a winner if evidence is insufficient.
Explicitly distinguish direct evidence from transferability/inference.
Treat NCA synthesis evidence as common feasibility unless candidate-specific synthesis evidence is supplied.
Chirality is outside this K/R/H identity-selection prompt. If K is selected, Lys chirality is resolved in a separate evidence step; no other amino-acid chirality is explored in V1.
